items.item_text: BLS and ACLS at time of hire with commitment to get ART within six (6) months of hire date.
Must be able to wear lead apron.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical
Experience in a hospital setting with knowledge of hemodynamic monitoring.

Under supervision, the Electrophysiology Cardiovascular Technologist assists with diagnostic and interventional angiographic cardiovascular electrophysiology procedures, including peripheral vascular, adult congenital and endovascular surgical procedures in the OR Hybrid room.

The EP Cardiovascular Technologist functions as an integral member of the Invasive Cardiology team, working with the Electrophysiology or Cardiovascular Cath labs. Performs specialized electrophysiology duties including operating, maintaining and proper functions of variety of ablation systems, pacing maneuvers and techniques, and EP mapping of cardiac anatomy. Under physician supervision, the cardiovascular technologist prepares, operates, and ensures the proper functioning of x-ray equipment associated with the performance of EP procedures. The EP cardiovascular technologist is responsible for radiation safety at all times and performs and documents quality checks and resolves imaging equipment issues. Demonstrates knowledge of human anatomy, cardiac rhythms, hemodynamic waveform analysis and performs hemodynamic calculations. General knowledge on the concepts of the physics of ultrasound and demonstrates advanced knowledge of echocardiographic procedures, cardiac anatomy and physiology with the understanding of cardiac ultrasound imaging techniques.

Scrubs into procedures by maintaining sterility and assists the physician with sterile supplies and equipment at the procedure table. Contributes to and participates in training and evaluation of staff as a member of self-directed work teams. Participates in performance improvement projects within the department. Additionally, this role may assist in the Electrophysiology/pacemaker clinic. Must be certified in Advanced Cardiac Life Support/Advance Resuscitation Training. Responsibilities include "on-call" as assigned. Performs other duties assigned as needed.
Registered Cardiovascular Invasive Specialist (RCIS) or Registered Cardiac Electrophysiology Specialist(RCES) within the first year of appointment.
Graduation from an Accredited Cardiovascular Program or Allied Health Program
Must obtain Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) within 3 months of appointment.
Demonstrates ability to identify pressure wave forms in all cardiac chambers and to identify and interpret EKG tracing.
